narration: The input content image of the cat is processed through the Content LoRA low-rank decomposition matrices.
Simultaneously, the reference style painting is mapped through the Style LoRA decomposition matrices.
Within K-LoRA, top-K salient elements are extracted from both branches, with style features scaled before summation.
The Judge module evaluates the combined signals to identify and route features to the attention layer with a larger top-K capacity.
These modulated attention features are added directly into the corresponding target layer of the diffusion backbone network.
The diffusion model synthesizes the final image, seamlessly blending the cat's content with the artistic painterly style.
